payload.friendly_name: Analyze: full planning corpus and product coherence
payload.purpose_context: Today /spec-kitty.analyze checks only spec, plan, tasks and WP prompts for mechanical consistency. Research decisions, data models, contracts, quickstart scenarios and the original intent recorded at mission creation can contradict the tasks unnoticed, and an internally consistent plan can still be overbuilt, missing its smallest valuable slice or drifting from what the user asked for. This mission extends the analyze step prompt (and its cave-kitty copy) with a planning-artifact consistency pass and an advisory product-coherence pass, staying prompt-only and read-only.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make the analyze readiness gate review the whole planning corpus and whether the plan still serves the user's goal.

options: Advisory: capped at MEDIUM, never block
payload.question: How do product-coherence findings affect severity and the readiness verdict?

payload.final_answer: Advisory: capped at MEDIUM, never block; a mandatory Recommendation line (revise spec | revise plan | revise tasks | proceed) is still emitted. Planning-artifact contradictions (#213) keep normal severity. (Operator ruling 2026-11-20.)

options: Fold helpful #247 changes in; close #247 via the PR
payload.question: Does the #247 follow-up fold into this mission?

payload.final_answer: Fold in: the Step-0 review squad found helpful changes (scenario rows that become S findings, Inferred: placement, test pins); close #247 via this PR. (Operator ruling.)

options: One prompt-only read-only mission covering both
payload.question: One mission or separate missions for #213 and #214?

payload.final_answer: One prompt-only, read-only mission covering #213 + #214 (+ #247 folds). (Operator ruling.)
